title: QuizLabs - Overview
description: QuizLabs legacy stack (quiz-backend, quiz-multiplayer/Socket.IO, MongoDB, Redis): readiness, route-bound edge traffic, resources, storage and logs. There are no application metrics, so nothing here counts players or games.

panels.title: Backend, multiplayer, frontend and Redis: available / desired replicas
panels.description: Available over desired replicas for each QuizLabs Deployment, from Kubernetes readiness. Readiness is not a successful datastore command; below 1, check restarts and logs.

panels.title: MongoDB: ready / desired StatefulSet replicas
panels.description: Ready over desired MongoDB StatefulSet replicas; QuizLabsMongoUnavailable fires when none is ready. Readiness says nothing about replication or command latency.

panels.title: QuizLabs route upstream requests / 15 minutes
panels.description: Envoy requests to the httproute/quizlabs/quizlabs/ clusters only: rule 0 backend, rule 1 Socket.IO, rule 2 frontend. Polling and upgrade requests are not game messages.

panels.title: QuizLabs route upstream connect failures and timeouts / 15 minutes
panels.description: Failed upstream connections and request timeouts per QuizLabs route (rule 0 backend, 1 Socket.IO, 2 frontend). Any value means Envoy could not reach that backend; check its readiness and logs.

panels.title: Socket.IO route active proxy connections (not users or sessions)
panels.description: Open Envoy connections to the Socket.IO backend (route rule 1). These are proxy connections, not players, rooms or WebSocket sessions.

panels.title: QuizLabs container restarts / 15 minutes
panels.description: Container restarts over the previous 15 minutes. Check Recent OOM restarts and the component's logs below for the cause.

panels.title: QuizLabs container CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used per QuizLabs container. A sustained climb alongside restarts points at that component.

panels.title: QuizLabs container memory working set
panels.description: Memory working set per QuizLabs container. Compare with its limit in the panel below before changing limits.

panels.title: QuizLabs memory working set / configured limit
panels.description: Working set as a percentage of the configured memory limit; containers without a limit have no line. Near 100% the container is OOM-killed.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="quizlabs",container!="",container!="POD"}) / on (namespace, pod, container) (max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="quizlabs",resource="memory",unit="byte"}) > 0)

panels.title: Recent OOM restarts
panels.description: Containers whose last termination was an OOM kill and that restarted in the last 15 minutes. Empty means none observed, not complete coverage.

panels.title: QuizLabs data-store PVC used / capacity
panels.description: Kubelet-reported used and capacity bytes of the QuizLabs PVCs (MongoDB, Redis). openebs-hostpath volumes may report the whole node filesystem; see Platform - Storage.

panels.title: QuizLabs Flux delivery state
panels.description: Readiness of the Flux objects that deliver QuizLabs. A not-ready object means the cluster is not running what Git says; see Platform - Delivery & Edge.

panels.title: quiz-backend logs only
panels.description: Raw quiz-backend logs. Legacy logs are unstructured: evidence, not a failure count.

panels.title: quiz-multiplayer / Socket.IO logs only
panels.description: Raw quiz-multiplayer (Socket.IO) logs. Legacy logs are unstructured: evidence, not a failure count.

panels.title: QuizLabs MongoDB logs only
panels.description: Raw MongoDB logs. Without a MongoDB exporter these are the only view of the database itself.

panels.title: QuizLabs Redis logs only
panels.description: Raw Redis logs. Without a Redis exporter these are the only view of the cache itself.
